title: Fixed-smoothing Uniform Inference for Quantile Regression
abstract: arXiv:2609.05883v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper develops fixed-smoothing inference methods for time-series quantile regression that are robust to heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation. Our approach is uniformly valid over quantile levels and accounts for dependence over time and across quantiles. It enables uniform confidence bands, Wald and Sup-t tests for joint hypotheses, and tests of shape restrictions, providing a unified framework for assessing heterogeneity in quantile effects. Under weak dependence, uniform inference for quantile regression processes is non-pivotal because the limiting distributions depend on the long-run covariance structure across quantiles. To address this issue, we develop two complementary approaches. The uniform-in-$\tau$ method estimates this structure and simulates the non-pivotal limiting distribution. translated_title: 分位数回归的固定平滑一致推断
translated_abstract: 本文针对时间序列分位数回归发展了固定平滑推断方法，该方法对异方差和自相关具有稳健性。我们的方法在所有分位数水平上一致有效，并考虑了时间维度和分位数之间的相依性。它能够构建一致置信带、用于联合假设的Wald检验和Sup-t检验，以及形状限制检验，为评估分位数效应的异质性提供了一个统一框架。在弱相依条件下，分位数回归过程的一致推断是非枢轴的，因为其极限分布依赖于分位数之间的长期协方差结构。为解决这一问题，我们发展了两种互补的方法：关于τ的一致方法通过估计该结构并模拟非枢轴极限分布；对于涉及有限个分位数的某些检验，堆叠Wald方法则提供枢轴化的固定平滑推断。
tldr: 本文为时间序列分位数回归提出了对异方差和自相关稳健的固定平滑一致推断方法，通过“一致于τ”和“堆叠Wald”两种互补策略解决非枢轴极限分布问题，为评估分位数效应异质性提供了统一推断框架。
en_tdlr: This paper develops fixed-smoothing uniform inference methods for time-series quantile regression that are robust to heteroskedasticity and autocorrelation, addressing non-pivotal limiting distributions via two complementary approaches (uniform-in-τ and stack-Wald) to provide a unified framework for assessing heterogeneity in quantile effects.
